title: Scientific Studies: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: John Oliver's Last Week Tonight segment on how media outlets report incomplete or untrue findings as settled science. It covers sensational headlines, small studies and pressure on researchers.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an entertaining and sophisticated primer on reading science reporting critically.

quote.text: John Oliver has a great segment called 'Scientific Studies' I'll link at the end of this post, everyone should watch this.
